subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram native Thinking indicator via Bot API 10.2

question: Should OpenClaw extend the existing Telegram native tool-progress draft lane to use Bot API 10.2 rich Thinking drafts for generic in-flight status, or retain the current text/status-draft behavior?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new Telegram-only presentation mode with client-compatibility, privacy, and configuration-policy tradeoffs; source and docs establish overlapping functionality but do not establish that the richer indicator is the intended product direction.

options.title: Adopt a bounded rich Thinking lane
options.body: Add a DM-only rich Thinking draft under the existing streaming and rich-message policy, with refresh and normal-delivery fallback coverage.

options.title: Keep the current native status drafts
options.body: Retain native `sendMessageDraft` tool-progress previews and typing for pure generation until richer Telegram clients are a clearer supported baseline.

options.title: Request an API-shape proposal first
options.body: Ask for a focused design that states whether existing `richMessages` and streaming controls are sufficient before accepting any new per-account setting.

recommendation.title: Adopt a bounded rich Thinking lane
recommendation.body: Add a DM-only rich Thinking draft under the existing streaming and rich-message policy, with refresh and normal-delivery fallback coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle merged the related Telegram progress-draft implementation and is the strongest available product-routing signal from the reviewed history.
